Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL—Single Server now available in the France South region

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL—Single Server is now generally available in the France South region, providing a premier managed open-source database offering. Take advantage of additional flexibility in deploying solutions that help accelerate innovation with fully managed and intelligent Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

For current information about the regional availability of Azure Database for PostgreSQL—Single Server, see Products available by region.
